    <h2>{`What is a Data Source?`}</h2>
    <p>{`A `}<strong parentName="p">{`data source`}</strong>{` in Graphite is a component that provides data to UI components. It acts as a bridge between your data (whether from APIs, local files, or Maximo servers) and the visual elements that display that data. Data sources handle all the complex operations of loading, caching, filtering, searching, paginating, and modifying data, so you can focus on building your UI.`}</p>
    <p>{`Think of a data source as a smart data container that:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Loads and caches`}</strong>{` records from various sources`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Searches, filters, and paginates`}</strong>{` data efficiently`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Saves, adds, updates, and deletes`}</strong>{` data with built-in change tracking`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Notifies`}</strong>{` UI components when data changes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Manages`}</strong>{` data state and synchronization`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Key Benefits`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Separation of Concerns`}</strong>{`: Data logic is separated from UI logic`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Automatic UI Updates`}</strong>{`: When data changes, connected UI components automatically update`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Built-in Operations`}</strong>{`: Common data operations (CRUD) are handled for you`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Performance`}</strong>{`: Intelligent caching and loading strategies`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Consistency`}</strong>{`: Standardized way to work with data across your application`}</li>
    </ul>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Types of Data Sources`}</h2>
    <p>{`Graphite provides three types of data sources, each suited for different use cases:`}</p>
    <h3>{`1. `}<inlineCode parentName="h3">{`<json-datasource>`}</inlineCode></h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`: Client-side, in-memory data source for non-Maximo data.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Best for`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Loading data from REST APIs`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Working with local JSON files`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Client-side data manipulation`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Testing and prototyping`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Data that doesn’t come from Maximo`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<json-datasource id="itemsDS" src="loader.js" pre-load="true" />
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`2. `}<inlineCode parentName="h3">{`<maximo-datasource>`}</inlineCode></h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`: Connects directly to Maximo OSLC APIs for server-side data.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Best for`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Loading Maximo business objects (Work Orders, Assets, etc.)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Server-side filtering and querying`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Working with Maximo object structures`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Enterprise data that requires security and validation`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Data that needs to be synchronized with Maximo`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="workOrderDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL" 
  where="status='WAPPR'">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="wonum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`3. `}<inlineCode parentName="h3">{`<custom-datasource>`}</inlineCode></h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`: Fully custom data adapter for specialized requirements.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Best for`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Complex data operations not covered by json or maximo datasources`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Custom data sources with unique protocols`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Advanced scenarios requiring full control`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Note`}</strong>{`: This is rarely needed. Most use cases are covered by `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "#1-json-datasource"
      }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode></a>{` or `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "#2-maximo-datasource"
      }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`maximo-datasource`}</inlineCode></a>{`.`}</p>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Data Source Lifecycle Events`}</h2>
    <p>{`Data sources provide lifecycle hooks that allow you to execute custom logic at specific points in the data source’s lifecycle. These events are defined in a `}<strong parentName="p">{`controller`}</strong>{` attached to the data source.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Attaching a Controller`}</h3>
    <p>{`Controllers are JavaScript classes that handle data source events and custom logic:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<json-datasource 
  controller="DataController" 
  id="myDS" 
  src="data.js"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`The controller file (`}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`DataController.js`}</inlineCode>{`):`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  // Lifecycle events go here
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Core Lifecycle Events`}</h3>
    <h4>{`1. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onDatasourceInitialized(datasource)`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called once when the data source is first created and initialized.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`: `}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Store reference to the data source`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Perform one-time setup`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Initialize state or variables`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource) {
    this.datasource = datasource;
    console.log('Datasource initialized:', datasource.id);
    
    // Store reference to app for later use
    this.app = this.datasource.app;
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`2. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onBeforeLoadData(datasource, query)`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called before data is loaded from the source.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Modify the query before it’s sent`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Add filters or parameters`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Validate load conditions`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Cancel the load by returning `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`false`}</inlineCode></li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: The data source instance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`query`}</inlineCode>{`: The query object that will be used to load data`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  onBeforeLoadData(datasource, query) {
    console.log('About to load data with query:', query);
    
    // Add a custom filter
    if (!query.where) {
      query.where = '';
    }
    query.where += ' and status="ACTIVE"';
    
    // Or prevent loading under certain conditions
    if (!this.app.state.userCanLoad) {
      console.log('User not authorized to load data');
      return false; // Cancel the load
    }
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`3. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onAfterLoadData(datasource, items, query)`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called after data is loaded but `}<strong parentName="p">{`before`}</strong>{` it’s merged into the data source.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Transform or enrich loaded data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Add calculated fields`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Filter items client-side`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Modify items before they’re displayed`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: The data source instance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`items`}</inlineCode>{`: Array of loaded items (can be modified)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`query`}</inlineCode>{`: The query that was used to load data`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important`}</strong>{`: This is your chance to mutate items before they become part of the data source state.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  onAfterLoadData(datasource, items, query) {
    console.log(\`Loaded \${items.length} items\`);
    
    // Add calculated fields
    items.forEach(item => {
      item.fullName = \`\${item.firstName} \${item.lastName}\`;
      item.isUrgent = item.priority > 8;
      
      // Format dates
      if (item.createdDate) {
        item.formattedDate = new Date(item.createdDate)
          .toLocaleDateString();
      }
    });
    
    // Filter items client-side
    return items.filter(item => item.isActive);
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`4. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onLoadDataFailed(error, datasource, query)`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called when data loading fails.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Handle errors gracefully`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Show user-friendly error messages`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Log errors for debugging`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Implement retry logic`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`error`}</inlineCode>{`: The error object`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: The data source instance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`query`}</inlineCode>{`: The query that failed`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  onLoadDataFailed(error, datasource, query) {
    console.error('Failed to load data:', error);
    
    // Show user-friendly message
    this.app.toast(
      'Unable to load data. Please try again.',
      'error'
    );
    
    // Log for debugging
    console.log('Failed query:', query);
    
    // Optionally retry
    if (this.retryCount < 3) {
      this.retryCount++;
      setTimeout(() => {
        datasource.load();
      }, 2000);
    }
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`5. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onBeforeSaveData({datasource, items})`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called before modified items are saved.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Validate data before saving`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Add additional fields`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Transform data for the server`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Cancel save by returning `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`false`}</inlineCode></li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters`}</strong>{`: Object containing:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: The data source instance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`items`}</inlineCode>{`: Array of items to be saved`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  onBeforeSaveData({datasource, items}) {
    console.log('About to save items:', items);
    
    // Validate all items
    for (let item of items) {
      if (!item.description || item.description.trim() === '') {
        this.app.toast('Description is required', 'error');
        return false; // Cancel save
      }
      
      // Add audit fields
      item.modifiedBy = this.app.state.currentUser;
      item.modifiedDate = new Date().toISOString();
    }
    
    return true; // Proceed with save
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`6. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onAfterSaveData({datasource, items})`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called after items are successfully saved.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Show success messages`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Trigger related actions`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Update other data sources`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Navigate to another page`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters`}</strong>{`: Object containing:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: The data source instance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`items`}</inlineCode>{`: Array of items that were saved`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  async onAfterSaveData({datasource, items}) {
    console.log('Successfully saved items:', items);
    
    // Show success message
    this.app.toast(
      \`\${items.length} item(s) saved successfully\`,
      'success'
    );
    
    // Reload related data sources
    const relatedDS = this.app.findDatasource('relatedData');
    if (relatedDS) {
      await relatedDS.forceReload();
    }
    
    // Navigate back
    this.app.navigateBack();
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`7. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onValueChanged({datasource, item, field, oldValue, newValue})`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called whenever a field value changes in any item.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`React to field changes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Implement dependent field logic`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Validate changes in real-time`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Update calculated fields`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters`}</strong>{`: Object containing:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: The data source instance`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`item`}</inlineCode>{`: The item that changed`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`field`}</inlineCode>{`: The field name that changed`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`oldValue`}</inlineCode>{`: The previous value`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`newValue`}</inlineCode>{`: The new value`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  onValueChanged({datasource, item, field, oldValue, newValue}) {
    console.log(\`\${field} changed from \${oldValue} to \${newValue}\`);
    
    // Dependent field logic
    if (field === 'quantity') {
      item.totalPrice = item.quantity * item.unitPrice;
    }
    
    if (field === 'priority') {
      // Auto-set status based on priority
      if (newValue >= 9) {
        item.status = 'URGENT';
      }
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (field === 'email') {
      const emailRegex = /^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/;
      item.emailValid = emailRegex.test(newValue);
    }
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>

    <h2>{`Complete Lifecycle Example`}</h2>
    <p>{`Here’s a comprehensive example showing all lifecycle events working together:`}</p>
    <h3>{`XML Declaration`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<application id="myApp">
  <datasources>
    <json-datasource 
      id="employeeDS" 
      controller="EmployeeController"
      src="employees.js"
      pre-load="true"/>
  </datasources>
  
  <page id="employeePage">
    <data-list datasource="employeeDS">
      <list-item>
        <label label="{item.fullName}"/>
        <label label="{item.department}"/>
      </list-item>
    </data-list>
  </page>
</application>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Controller Implementation`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class EmployeeController {
  constructor() {
    this.retryCount = 0;
    this.maxRetries = 3;
  }

  // 1. Initialization
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource) {
    this.datasource = datasource;
    this.app = datasource.app;
    console.log('Employee datasource initialized');
  }

  // 2. Before loading
  onBeforeLoadData(datasource, query) {
    console.log('Loading employees...');
    
    // Add department filter if set
    if (this.app.state.selectedDepartment) {
      query.department = this.app.state.selectedDepartment;
    }
    
    // Show loading indicator
    this.app.state.isLoading = true;
  }

  // 3. After loading - transform data
  onAfterLoadData(datasource, items, query) {
    console.log(\`Loaded \${items.length} employees\`);
    
    // Enrich data
    items.forEach(item => {
      // Create full name
      item.fullName = \`\${item.firstName} \${item.lastName}\`;
      
      // Calculate years of service
      if (item.hireDate) {
        const years = new Date().getFullYear() - 
                     new Date(item.hireDate).getFullYear();
        item.yearsOfService = years;
        item.isVeteran = years >= 10;
      }
      
      // Add display status
      item.statusDisplay = item.active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive';
    });
    
    // Hide loading indicator
    this.app.state.isLoading = false;
    
    // Reset retry count on success
    this.retryCount = 0;
    
    return items;
  }

  // 4. Handle load failures
  onLoadDataFailed(error, datasource, query) {
    console.error('Failed to load employees:', error);
    
    this.app.state.isLoading = false;
    
    // Retry logic
    if (this.retryCount < this.maxRetries) {
      this.retryCount++;
      this.app.toast(
        \`Loading failed. Retrying (\${this.retryCount}/\${this.maxRetries})...\`,
        'warning'
      );
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        datasource.load();
      }, 2000);
    } else {
      this.app.toast(
        'Unable to load employees. Please check your connection.',
        'error'
      );
    }
  }

  // 5. Before saving
  onBeforeSaveData({datasource, items}) {
    console.log('Validating before save...');
    
    for (let item of items) {
      // Required field validation
      if (!item.firstName || !item.lastName) {
        this.app.toast('First and last name are required', 'error');
        return false;
      }
      
      // Email validation
      if (item.email) {
        const emailRegex = /^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/;
        if (!emailRegex.test(item.email)) {
          this.app.toast('Invalid email format', 'error');
          return false;
        }
      }
      
      // Add audit fields
      item.modifiedBy = this.app.state.currentUser;
      item.modifiedDate = new Date().toISOString();
    }
    
    return true;
  }

  // 6. After saving
  async onAfterSaveData({datasource, items}) {
    console.log('Save successful');
    
    this.app.toast(
      \`\${items.length} employee(s) updated successfully\`,
      'success'
    );
    
    // Reload related data
    const deptDS = this.app.findDatasource('departmentDS');
    if (deptDS) {
      await deptDS.forceReload();
    }
  }

  // 7. Field value changes
  onValueChanged({datasource, item, field, oldValue, newValue}) {
    console.log(\`\${field}: \${oldValue} → \${newValue}\`);
    
    // Update full name when first or last name changes
    if (field === 'firstName' || field === 'lastName') {
      item.fullName = \`\${item.firstName || ''} \${item.lastName || ''}\`.trim();
    }
    
    // Auto-calculate salary grade
    if (field === 'salary') {
      if (newValue < 50000) {
        item.salaryGrade = 'Entry';
      } else if (newValue < 100000) {
        item.salaryGrade = 'Mid';
      } else {
        item.salaryGrade = 'Senior';
      }
    }
    
    // Department change triggers validation
    if (field === 'department') {
      this.validateDepartmentChange(item, oldValue, newValue);
    }
  }

  // Helper method
  validateDepartmentChange(item, oldDept, newDept) {
    if (oldDept && oldDept !== newDept) {
      console.log(\`Employee moving from \${oldDept} to \${newDept}\`);
      // Could trigger approval workflow, etc.
    }
  }
}

export default EmployeeController;
`}</code></pre>

    <h2>{`Key Differences: json-datasource vs maximo-datasource`}</h2>
    <table>
      <thead parentName="table">
        <tr parentName="thead">
          <th parentName="tr" {...{
            "align": null
          }}>{`Feature`}</th>

          }}>{`json-datasource`}</th>

        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody parentName="table">
        <tr parentName="tbody">
          <td parentName="tr" {...{
            "align": null
          }}><strong parentName="td">{`Data Source`}</strong></td>
          <td parentName="tr" {...{
            "align": null
          }}>{`REST APIs, local files, custom loaders`}</td>
          <td parentName="tr" {...{
            "align": null

        <tr parentName="tbody">
          <td parentName="tr" {...{

          }}><strong parentName="td">{`Data Location`}</strong></td>
          <td parentName="tr" {...{

    <h3>{`json-datasource Example`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<json-datasource id="productsDS" src="products.js" pre-load="true">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="id" type="INTEGER"/>
    <attribute name="name" type="STRING"/>
    <attribute name="price" type="DECIMAL"/>
  </schema>
</json-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Understanding Loader Functions`}</h4>
    <p>{`A `}<strong parentName="p">{`loader function`}</strong>{` is an async JavaScript function that fetches and returns data for a `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "#1-json-datasource"
      }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode></a>{`. It’s the recommended way to load data because it provides flexibility, maintainability, and follows best practices.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Why Use a Loader Function?`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Asynchronous Data Loading`}</strong>{`: Loader functions are async, allowing you to fetch data from APIs, databases, or any asynchronous source without blocking the UI.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Dynamic Data`}</strong>{`: Unlike static arrays, loader functions can fetch fresh data each time the datasource loads, ensuring your UI always displays current information.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Query Parameter Support`}</strong>{`: The loader receives a `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`query`}</inlineCode>{` parameter, allowing you to implement filtering, sorting, and pagination based on user interactions.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Error Handling`}</strong>{`: You can implement proper error handling and retry logic within the loader function.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Reusability`}</strong>{`: Loader functions can be shared across multiple datasources or applications.`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Testability`}</strong>{`: Isolated loader functions are easier to unit test than inline data loading logic.`}</p>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Loader file (products.js)`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const loader = async (query) => {
  // The query parameter contains any filters, search terms, or parameters
  // passed when the datasource loads
  console.log('Loading with query:', query);
  
  try {
    // Fetch data from your API
    const response = await fetch('/api/products');
    
    // Check if the request was successful
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(\`HTTP error! status: \${response.status}\`);
    }
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    // Return an object with an 'items' array
    // This is the required format for json-datasource
    return {
      items: data.products
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load products:', error);
    // Return empty array on error, or re-throw to trigger onLoadDataFailed
    throw error;
  }
};

export default loader;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Advanced Loader Examples:`}</strong></p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`1. Loader with Query Parameters:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const loader = async (query) => {
  // Build URL with query parameters
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  
  if (query.search) {
    params.append('search', query.search);
  }
  
  if (query.category) {
    params.append('category', query.category);
  }
  
  if (query.limit) {
    params.append('limit', query.limit);
  }
  
  const url = \`/api/products?\${params.toString()}\`;
  const response = await fetch(url);
  const data = await response.json();
  
  return {
    items: data.products,
    totalCount: data.total // Optional: for pagination
  };
};

export default loader;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`2. Loader with Authentication:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const loader = async (query) => {
  // Get auth token from app state or storage
  const token = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
  
  const response = await fetch('/api/products', {
    headers: {
      'Authorization': \`Bearer \${token}\`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
  });
  
  const data = await response.json();
  
  return {
    items: data.products
  };
};

export default loader;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`3. Loader with Data Transformation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const loader = async (query) => {
  const response = await fetch('/api/products');
  const data = await response.json();
  
  // Transform data before returning
  const transformedItems = data.products.map(product => ({
    ...product,
    // Add calculated fields
    displayPrice: \`$\${product.price.toFixed(2)}\`,
    inStock: product.quantity > 0,
    // Format dates
    createdDate: new Date(product.created).toLocaleDateString()
  }));
  
  return {
    items: transformedItems
  };
};

export default loader;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`4. Loader with Multiple Data Sources:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const loader = async (query) => {
  // Fetch from multiple endpoints in parallel
  const [productsRes, categoriesRes] = await Promise.all([
    fetch('/api/products'),
    fetch('/api/categories')
  ]);
  
  const products = await productsRes.json();
  const categories = await categoriesRes.json();
  
  // Create a category lookup map
  const categoryMap = {};
  categories.forEach(cat => {
    categoryMap[cat.id] = cat.name;
  });
  
  // Enrich products with category names
  const enrichedProducts = products.map(product => ({
    ...product,
    categoryName: categoryMap[product.categoryId]
  }));
  
  return {
    items: enrichedProducts
  };
};

export default loader;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`5. Loader with Local Data (for testing):`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const loader = async (query) => {
  // Simulate API delay
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
  
  // Return mock data
  return {
    items: [
      { id: 1, name: 'Product 1', price: 29.99 },
      { id: 2, name: 'Product 2', price: 39.99 },
      { id: 3, name: 'Product 3', price: 49.99 }
    ]
  };
};

export default loader;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When NOT to Use a Loader Function:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`When you have truly static data that never changes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`For very simple prototypes where you just need placeholder data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`When the data is already available in the application state`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p>{`However, even in these cases, using a loader function is still recommended for consistency and future flexibility.`}</p>
    <h3>{`maximo-datasource Example`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="workOrderDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL"
  where="status in ['WAPPR','INPRG']"
  order-by="wonum desc">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="wonum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="worktype"/>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="location"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Differences in Usage`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Loading Data`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: Uses loader function or static data`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`maximo-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: Queries Maximo using object-structure and where clause`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Schema Definition`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: Schema is optional, mainly for validation`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`maximo-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: Schema is required, maps to Maximo attributes`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Filtering`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: All filtering happens client-side after load`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`maximo-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: Server-side filtering via `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`where`}</inlineCode>{` clause, plus client-side`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Relationships`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: Must manually load related data`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`maximo-datasource`}</inlineCode>{`: Can use relationship paths (e.g., `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`asset.assetnum`}</inlineCode>{`)`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Common Data Source Operations`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Accessing a Data Source`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// In a controller

// In a page controller
const ds = this.page.findDatasource('myDS');
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Loading Data`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// Force reload from source

// Load with custom query

  where: 'status="ACTIVE"',
  orderBy: 'name'
});
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Searching`}</h3>

        "className": "language-js"

// QBE (Query By Example) search

});

// Clear search

`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Iterating Items`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

    <h3>{`CRUD Operations`}</h3>
    <h4>{`Create`}</h4>

        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`let newItem = await ds.addNew();
newItem.name = 'New Item';

    <h4>{`Update`}</h4>

    <h4>{`Delete`}</h4>

        "className": "language-js"

    <h3>{`Undo Changes`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// Undo changes to a specific item

// Undo all changes

    <h3>{`Filtering`}</h3>

    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <h3>{`✅ Do’s`}</h3>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use async loader functions`}</strong>{` for `}<a parentName="p" {...{
            "href": "#1-json-datasource"
          }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode></a></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-js"
          }}>{`const loader = async (query) => {
  const response = await fetch('/api/data');
  return { items: await response.json() };
};
export default loader;
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use `}<a parentName="strong" {...{
              "href": "#2-maximo-datasource"
            }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`maximo-datasource`}</inlineCode></a>{` for Maximo data`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<maximo-datasource object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL" ...>
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use `}<a parentName="strong" {...{
              "href": "smart-input"
            }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`smart-input`}</inlineCode></a>{` for editable forms`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`It automatically determines the correct input type from schema`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Transform data in `}<a parentName="strong" {...{
              "href": "#3-onafterloaddatasource-items-query"
            }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`onAfterLoadData`}</inlineCode></a></strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`This is the right place to enrich or modify loaded data`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Validate in `}<a parentName="strong" {...{
              "href": "#5-onbeforesavedatasource-items"
            }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`onBeforeSaveData`}</inlineCode></a></strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Prevent invalid data from being saved`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use `}<a parentName="strong" {...{
              "href": "#-depends-on"
            }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`depends-on`}</inlineCode></a>{` for load order`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<json-datasource id="ds2" depends-on="ds1"/>
`}</code></pre>

    </ol>
    <h3>{`❌ Don’ts`}</h3>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t use static arrays`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-js"
          }}>{`// ❌ Bad
ds.load({src: [{id: 1}, {id: 2}]});

// ✅ Good - use loader function
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t create controllers unnecessarily`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Only create controllers when you need custom logic`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t use basic inputs for datasource forms`}</strong></p>

            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<!-- ❌ Bad -->

<!-- ✅ Good -->

      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t forget error handling`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Always implement `}<a parentName="li" {...{
              "href": "#4-onloaddatafailederror-datasource-query"

        </ul>
      </li>

      </li>
    </ol>

    <h2>{`Advanced Topics`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Depends-On Relationships`}</h3>
    <p>{`Control the order in which data sources load:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<json-datasource id="departments" src="dept.js"/>
<json-datasource id="employees" src="emp.js" depends-on="departments"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`employees`}</inlineCode>{` datasource will wait until `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`departments`}</inlineCode>{` has loaded.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Child Datasources`}</h3>
    <p>{`For nested data relationships:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// Get child datasource for a specific item
const childDS = await parentDS.getChildDatasource(
  'doclinks', 
  item, 
  {query: {attachment: true}}
);
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Conditional Loading`}</h3>
    <p>{`Prevent loading until conditions are met:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<json-datasource 
  id="myDS" 
  src="data.js"
  can-load="{app.state.userAuthenticated}"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Pre-loading`}</h3>
    <p>{`Load data immediately when the datasource is created:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<json-datasource id="myDS" src="data.js" pre-load="true"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Summary`}</h2>
    <p>{`Data sources are the backbone of Graphite applications, providing a consistent and powerful way to manage data. Key takeaways:`}</p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Choose the right type`}</strong>{`: Use `}<a parentName="li" {...{
          "href": "#1-json-datasource"
        }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`json-datasource`}</inlineCode></a>{` for non-Maximo data, `}<a parentName="li" {...{
          "href": "#2-maximo-datasource"
        }}><inlineCode parentName="a">{`maximo-datasource`}</inlineCode></a>{` for Maximo data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Leverage lifecycle events`}</strong>{`: Use controllers to customize behavior at key points`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Follow best practices`}</strong>{`: Use async loaders, validate before save, transform after load`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Keep it simple`}</strong>{`: Only add controllers when you need custom logic`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p>{`By understanding data sources and their lifecycle, you can build robust, maintainable Graphite applications that efficiently manage data from any source.`}</p>
